newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hutchinson Tech Q1 upped. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hutchinson Tech Q1 upped. [CORRECTED 16:25 GMT]

text.p: -- Olde Discount analyst Cody Acree said Tuesday he raised his earnings estimate for Hutchinson Technology Inc for the first quarter ending in December to $1.70 per share from $0.75.
-- "We are not altering forward quarterly estimates...at this point," he said.

-- Earlier on Tuesday, Hutchinson, which makes suspension assemblies for disk drives, said it expects first-quarter earnings of between $1.50 and $1.90 per share versus $0.51 year-ago after a $0.69 per share charge.
-- On Tuesday, Hutchinson shares rose 14-1/2 to 67-1/4.

-- Acree said he expected the average selling price to remain fairly stable but said demand has been strong into the holiday season and that inventories for the majority of the personal computer and component market seem fairly low.
-- He said Hutchinson about a month ago was shipping roughly 11.9 million units per week and that he now figures it is shipping in the low- to mid-12 million units range a week.
-- The company projected its fiscal first quarter 1997 net sales as ranging between $104 million to $109 million.
-- "For them to meet that, their weekly shipment rate with flat selling prices puts them in the low- to mid-12 (corrects from 21) million units per week," Acree added.
